show_notes: Light came early, cut the closer.
observations: Everyone on the train pretends the seat next to them is reserved for an invisible friend.
Cab drivers ask 'which route?' as if I have a favourite.
My mum forwards every message with 'see this', never 'see this, it's fake'.
Family group chats are 90% good-morning images.
Meetings that could have been an email become emails that should have been a meeting.
The office fridge has a sign, a rota and still a mystery yoghurt.
Lift small talk peaks at 'which floor?'.

Write the topic in the middle and branch out everything it touches.

- What else does this word mean?
- What's the opposite?
- Who would hate this most?
Pick a topic and rant about why it's **hard**, **weird**, **scary** or **stupid**. Don't try to be funny; be honest and logical.
Two items set the pattern; the third breaks it.

session.title: Smart homes
session.content:
Smart fridge orders milk when I run out. Who asked it to judge my milk habits?

The lights won't turn on until I say please. My house has better manners than my flatmate.

What if the doorbell starts screening my friends?

rewrite.title: Smart fridge, sharper
versions: So I bought a smart fridge. It knows when I'm out of milk.
So I bought a smart fridge. It knows when I'm out of milk, and it tells my mum.
So I bought a smart fridge. Now my milk has a better support system than I do.
